blocks.title: CQG algebras and quantum dimensions
blocks.content:
[]{#CQG label="CQG"}

The category of Compact Quantum Group algebras ([CQG ]{.sans-serif}) is a full subcategory of the category of Hopf $*$-algebras that includes the standard noncommutative deformations of algebras of representative functions on compact Lie groups. In particular, [CQG ]{.sans-serif}algebras are Hopf $*$-algebras with positive definite Haar functionals which have natural analogs of the Peter-Weyl decomposition and the Schur orthogonality relations. This leads to the notion of the quantum dimension of an irreducible, finite dimensional comodule over a given [CQG ]{.sans-serif}

blocks.content: Let $\mathcal{U}_q$ be the quantized universal enveloping algebra of $\mathfrak{gl}_n(\mathbb{C})$, where $0<q<1$.
